_doc: KĀLA-YANTRA fixed-operation table (charter §7). The executor reads THIS FILE FROM origin/main (never from a working tree) and refuses any kind not listed or not enabled. Enabling an entry is a reviewed, merged change landed by the plan-model item named in `enabled_by`. FORMAT RULE: `enabled` is the FIRST key of every entry — the plan model's detectors read it. `script` is a repository-relative path; a read-only operation's script is extracted from origin/main; a production operation runs in a private worktree at the request's reviewed_commit (which must be merged). `fixed_args` are always passed; `allowed_args` are the request-arg keys that may be appended as --key value; `needs` is the capability; `requesters` are the lanes that may request the kind (default: adhikarin only); optional `cwd` (repository-relative), `python_module` (run as python -m) and `timeout_s`.
